dataset.name: DataSense (CIC IIoT 2025)
dataset.note: Per-device, 5-second-window aggregated sensor + network telemetry from a 40-device IIoT testbed (Firouzi et al., 2025).

models_sorted.name: XGBoost
models_sorted.description: Industry-standard regularized gradient boosting library, widely used in IDS/network-security literature.

models_sorted.name: XGBoost (DART)
models_sorted.description: XGBoost with DART dropout regularization -- randomly drops trees during boosting to reduce overfitting.

models_sorted.name: LightGBM
models_sorted.description: Microsoft's leaf-wise (rather than level-wise) gradient boosting framework, built for speed at scale.

models_sorted.name: LightGBM (GOSS)
models_sorted.description: LightGBM with Gradient-based One-Side Sampling -- keeps high-gradient samples, subsamples the rest for speed.

models_sorted.name: Hist Gradient Boosting
models_sorted.description: Histogram-binned gradient boosting (sklearn's LightGBM-style implementation) -- fast on large tabular data.

models_sorted.name: Explainable Boosting Machine
models_sorted.description: Microsoft InterpretML's glass-box GAM-style booster -- near-blackbox accuracy with fully inspectable per-feature shape functions.

models_sorted.name: Gradient Boosting (sklearn)
models_sorted.description: Classic stagewise gradient-boosted trees, scikit-learn's original (pre-histogram) implementation.

models_sorted.name: CatBoost
models_sorted.description: Yandex's ordered-boosting gradient boosting library, designed to reduce prediction shift/target leakage.

models_sorted.name: Voting Classifier (soft)
models_sorted.description: Averages predicted-probability outputs of Random Forest, HistGBM, and Logistic Regression.

models_sorted.name: Bagging (Decision Trees)
models_sorted.description: Classic bootstrap-aggregated decision trees (the general recipe Random Forest specializes).

models_sorted.name: Stacking Classifier
models_sorted.description: Random Forest, HistGBM, and KNN base predictions fed into a Logistic Regression meta-learner.

models_sorted.name: Extra Trees
models_sorted.description: 200 extremely-randomized trees bagged together -- usually faster to train than Random Forest, similar accuracy.

models_sorted.name: Random Forest
models_sorted.description: 200 bagged decision trees voting together -- the workhorse ensemble baseline.

models_sorted.name: Regularized Greedy Forest
models_sorted.description: Builds one shared tree structure that's fully re-optimized at every boosting step, rather than a growing ensemble.

models_sorted.name: Decision Tree
models_sorted.description: A single greedy-split tree -- the interpretable building block every ensemble below is made of.

models_sorted.name: Balanced Bagging
models_sorted.description: Bagged decision trees where every bootstrap sample is class-balanced before fitting.

models_sorted.name: Balanced Random Forest
models_sorted.description: Random Forest where every tree's bootstrap sample is rebalanced across classes -- built for exactly this kind of rare-attack-class skew.

models_sorted.name: NGBoost
models_sorted.description: Natural Gradient Boosting: boosts full predictive probability distributions, not just point predictions.

models_sorted.name: Bagging (KNN)
models_sorted.description: Bootstrap-aggregated k-nearest-neighbors -- tests whether bagging helps an already-low-bias model.

models_sorted.name: K-Nearest Neighbors (k=15, distance-weighted)
models_sorted.description: 15-neighbor vote weighted inversely by distance, so closer neighbors count more.

models_sorted.name: K-Nearest Neighbors (k=5)
models_sorted.description: Classifies by majority vote among the 5 nearest training points.

models_sorted.name: Extra Tree (single)
models_sorted.description: A single extremely-randomized tree: split thresholds are random rather than optimized, trading bias for variance.

models_sorted.name: FIGS (Fast Interpretable Greedy-Sums)
models_sorted.description: Sums a handful of small, jointly-fit trees into one interpretable additive model instead of one deep tree.

models_sorted.name: Extreme Learning Machine
models_sorted.description: Single hidden layer of fixed random (untrained) weights + closed-form ridge-regression readout -- no backprop.

models_sorted.name: SVM (RBF Kernel)
models_sorted.description: Support vector machine with a Gaussian (RBF) kernel for nonlinear decision boundaries.

models_sorted.name: SGD (Hinge / Linear SVM)
models_sorted.description: Linear support vector machine trained via online stochastic gradient descent.

models_sorted.name: SVM (Polynomial Kernel)
models_sorted.description: Support vector machine with a degree-3 polynomial kernel.

models_sorted.name: Linear SVC (liblinear)
models_sorted.description: Linear support vector classifier via liblinear's coordinate-descent solver -- scales far better than kernel SVC.

models_sorted.name: SVM (Linear Kernel)
models_sorted.description: Support vector machine with a linear decision boundary and margin-maximizing objective.

models_sorted.name: Linear Discriminant Analysis
models_sorted.description: Generative linear classifier assuming shared-covariance Gaussian class distributions.

models_sorted.name: Logistic Regression
models_sorted.description: Baseline linear classifier: a softmax over a weighted sum of features.

models_sorted.name: Logistic Regression (ElasticNet)
models_sorted.description: Logistic regression with combined L1+L2 regularization for sparser, more robust weights.

models_sorted.name: SGD (Log Loss)
models_sorted.description: Logistic regression trained via online stochastic gradient descent instead of a batch solver.

models_sorted.name: Perceptron
models_sorted.description: The original 1958 linear classifier: mistake-driven weight updates, no regularization by default.

models_sorted.name: AdaBoost
models_sorted.description: Sequentially reweights misclassified samples across shallow trees -- the original boosting algorithm.

models_sorted.name: SGD (Modified Huber)
models_sorted.description: Linear classifier with a loss that's robust to outliers while still yielding probability estimates.

models_sorted.name: Label Spreading
models_sorted.description: Graph-based transductive classifier that propagates labels through a similarity graph over the data.

models_sorted.name: Nystroem + SGD
models_sorted.description: Approximates an RBF kernel with a low-rank Nystroem feature map, then a fast linear SGD classifier on top.

models_sorted.name: Ridge Classifier
models_sorted.description: Least-squares classification with L2-regularized weights (no probabilistic loss).

models_sorted.name: Passive-Aggressive Classifier
models_sorted.description: Online linear classifier that stays passive on correct predictions and aggressively corrects on mistakes.

models_sorted.name: Bernoulli Naive Bayes
models_sorted.description: Naive Bayes over binarized (thresholded) features -- tests whether feature presence/absence alone is informative.

models_sorted.name: Easy Ensemble
models_sorted.description: Trains many AdaBoost ensembles, each on an independently balanced under-sample, then votes across all of them.

models_sorted.name: Nearest Centroid
models_sorted.description: Assigns each point to the class whose training-set centroid (mean) is closest -- essentially 1-NN against class means.

models_sorted.name: Self-Organizing Map Classifier
models_sorted.description: Kohonen self-organizing map used as a nearest-prototype classifier via majority vote per map unit.

models_sorted.name: Quadratic Discriminant Analysis
models_sorted.description: Like LDA but allows each class its own covariance shape -- a quadratic, not linear, decision boundary.

models_sorted.name: Gaussian Process Classifier
models_sorted.description: Bayesian non-parametric classifier over an RBF-kernel Gaussian Process posterior (O(n^3) -- heavily subsampled).

models_sorted.name: Gaussian Naive Bayes
models_sorted.description: Assumes each feature is independently Gaussian within a class -- a fast, strong baseline floor.

models_sorted.name: Complement Naive Bayes
models_sorted.description: Naive Bayes variant designed for imbalanced classes; complements weights to correct majority-class skew.

models_sorted.name: RBF Sampler + Ridge
models_sorted.description: Random Fourier Features approximation of an RBF kernel feeding a closed-form ridge classifier.

models_sorted.name: RUSBoost
models_sorted.description: AdaBoost with random under-sampling of the majority class before each boosting round.
